shelters.name: Kansas Humane Society
shelters.description: Wichita's largest privately funded nonprofit animal shelter. Committed to helping pets and people with adoption, spay/neuter, community outreach, animal rescue, and rehoming services.

shelters.name: Wichita Animal Services
shelters.description: Animal Control and Wichita Animal Shelter for stray, lost, and confiscated small animals. Campus shared with Kansas Humane Society.

shelters.name: Wichita Animal Action League (WAAL)
shelters.description: Nonprofit dedicated to rescuing animals in crisis. Depends on volunteers and donations to provide safe, loving homes and programs for pets and owners.

shelters.name: Lifeline Animal Placement and Protection
shelters.description: Wichita's only no-kill animal shelter. Nonprofit rescue saving animals that have been abandoned, abused or relinquished by owners.

shelters.name: Great Plains SPCA
shelters.description: Provides lifesaving services for approximately 6,800 animals annually in the greater Kansas City area. Exists because of caring Kansas City community and generous donors.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Greater Kansas City
shelters.description: Since 1912, saving and improving lives of dogs and cats throughout Greater Kansas City. Provides preventative medical care, spay/neuter, education, and adoptions.

shelters.name: Helping Hands Humane Society
shelters.description: Animal Resource Center of Northeast Kansas. Has dogs, cats, and pocket pets looking for loving homes and forever families.

shelters.name: Lawrence Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Lawrence and Douglas County with animal welfare services and adoption programs.

shelters.name: Heart of America Humane Society
shelters.description: 100% volunteer organization finding good homes for animals. Partnership with Lee's Summit Municipal Animal Shelter. Hosts adoption events at Olathe PetSmart.

shelters.name: T. Russell Reitz Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City of Manhattan shelter operated by Prairie Paws Animal Shelter since December 2023.

shelters.name: Purple Power Animal Welfare Society (Purple PAWS)
shelters.description: All-volunteer foster-based rescue founded 2012. Rescued more than 3,000 animals from death row and abusive/neglectful situations in Manhattan and Junction City area.

shelters.name: Riley County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Riley County and Manhattan area with animal rescue and adoption services.

shelters.name: Salina Animal Services
shelters.description: Since February 2015, striving for 90% live outcomes. Offers adoptions, reclaims, microchips, licensing, cruelty investigations, and educational programs.

shelters.name: Leavenworth County Humane Society
shelters.description: Originally founded in 1885, may be the oldest humane society in Kansas. Serving Leavenworth County with animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Olathe Animal Control Shelter
shelters.description: City of Olathe animal control providing shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Purrfect Pets Cat Adoptions
shelters.description: No-kill cat rescue organization serving the Olathe and Kansas City area.

shelters.name: SDRD Dog Rescue
shelters.description: State licensed 501(c)(3) no-kill dog rescue and group foster home. Networks with local rescues to save dogs at risk of euthanasia.

shelters.name: Purrecious 9 Lives Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit organization rescuing community cats since 2013 in Shawnee, Kansas.

shelters.name: Caring Hands Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Hutchinson and surrounding area with animal shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: Pratt Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Pratt area of south-central Kansas.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Kansas animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Kansas Humane Society is Wichita's largest privately funded shelter. Leavenworth County Humane Society (founded 1885) may be Kansas's oldest. Humane Society of Greater Kansas City has served since 1912. Coverage spans Wichita, Kansas City metro (Overland Park, Olathe, Merriam, Shawnee), Topeka, Lawrence, Manhattan, Salina, Hutchinson, and Leavenworth.
